skill.description: Skill name — must match the directory name under .claude/skills/

created_via.description: How this file was authored. Set to 'interview' when produced by /skill-eval:create-test.

id.description: Stable identifier within this file (e.g. s1, s2).

archetype.description: Difficulty hint. direct = clearly the skill's domain; adjacent = borderline; subtle = nuanced/easy-to-miss. Informational; does not change scoring rigor.

expectation.description: should_fire: this user_prompt MUST cause the skill to engage (trigger + apply). should_not_fire: this user_prompt MUST NOT engage the skill — it is a negative/decoy case to verify the skill does not over-trigger.

user_prompt.description: Verbatim user message sent to Copilot for both arms.

success_criteria.description: Observable bullets used by the evaluator's `success` axis. For should_fire scenarios, describe what a skill-engaged response should contain. For should_not_fire scenarios, describe what a correct non-skill response should look like (e.g. 'responds without invoking <skill>-specific structure', 'treats the request as off-topic for this skill').

skill_relevance.description: One sentence: which aspect of the skill this scenario exercises (or, for should_not_fire, why the skill MUST NOT engage). The evaluator uses this to ground the `skill_engagement` axis.
